cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

cards.name: Barbaracle
cards.description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.description: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.description: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Furret
cards.description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
